findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/config.js::findroot() resolves before the --absolute refusal guard in cmdconfig
findings.title: findRoot() resolves before the --absolute refusal guard in cmdConfig
findings.action: optionally hoist the guard above root resolution to refuse purely on the parse surface
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec-faithful: the spec's HOW PROCEDURE places the guard after `cmd = rest[0]` (which follows root resolution). findRoot() is a non-throwing pure resolver every config verb already runs; no filesystem/verb side effect precedes the refusal. Reordering would deviate from the approved insertion point for nil correctness gain.
